import os, socket, subprocess, sys, time, http.client, tempfile
def start():
    env = {"PATH": os.environ.get("PATH", ""), "HOME": os.environ.get("HOME", tempfile.gettempdir())}
    p = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "server.py"], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, env=env)
    deadline = time.time() + 6
    while time.time() < deadline:
        try:
            socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", 8000), timeout=0.5).close()
            return p
        except OSError:
            time.sleep(0.1)
    p.kill()
    sys.exit(1)
def get(timeout):
    c = http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1", 8000, timeout=timeout)
    c.request("GET", "/")
    r = c.getresponse()
    r.read()
    c.close()
    return r.status

p = start()
ok = False
idle = []
try:
    for _ in range(3):
        s = socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", 8000), timeout=2)
        s.sendall(b"GET / HTTP/1.1\r\n")  # incomplete request: blocks a single-threaded server
        idle.append(s)
    time.sleep(0.3)
    ok = get(4) == 200
except Exception:
    ok = False
finally:
    for s in idle:
        s.close()
    p.kill()
    p.wait()
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
